headline: S&A Law Offices acts on ₹1,601 crore sale of Air India Building, Mumbai to Government of Maharashtra
sum: AI Assets Holding Limited has made a sale and transfer of the iconic Air India Building, located at Nariman Point, Mumbai, to the Government of Maharashtra (through the Governor of Maharashtra) for a…
detail: AI Assets Holding Limited has made a sale and transfer of the iconic Air India Building, located at Nariman Point, Mumbai, to the Government of Maharashtra (through the Governor of Maharashtra) for a total consideration of ₹1,601 crore. S&A Law Offices acted for AI Assets Holding on this transaction. The transaction was led by Kumar Shashwat Singh Sawno (Partner), along with Vishal Singh (Principal Associate) and Rishabh Chauhan (Principal Associate).
